patterns.note: Alternating content blocks feature a large graphic or 3D illustration on one side and descriptive text with a call-to-action on the other, creating dynamic visual interest across sections.
Section headings are consistently rendered in a bold, uppercase sans-serif font, often in a dark green or black, providing strong visual anchors and a modern, authoritative tone.

A vibrant, almost neon green (#56e053) is used as the primary accent color for calls-to-action, key visual elements like the hero 3D graphic, and interactive states, creating high contrast against a clean white background.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as the user scrolls, and the hero features a dynamic 3D green blob that exhibits a slight parallax effect, moving slower than foreground elements.
Each major content section is introduced by a prominent, full-width, uppercase heading, clearly segmenting the page and guiding the user through the site's offerings.

technique_notes: Uses scroll-triggered animations (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger or similar) to reveal sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. The hero section features a dynamic 3D graphic (Lottie animation or video hero) that exhibits a slight parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text during scroll. The main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport after scrolling past the hero, transitioning from a transparent background to a solid, light background.

Utilizes a high-contrast color palette with a dominant vibrant green accent against a clean white background and dark text. Section headings are rendered in a bold, uppercase sans-serif font for strong visual impact. Product features are presented in distinct, rounded-corner cards with clear calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (up to ~4-5x body text) create strong hierarchy, complemented by clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and product cards, giving a soft, approachable feel. The main footer also has rounded ends.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, providing ample breathing room. Content within product cards is more balanced.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold and energetic use of a single, vibrant green as a primary accent color, paired with a dynamic, organic 3D graphic in the hero. This creates a distinctive, modern, and slightly playful yet authoritative feel, especially when combined with the strong, uppercase typography.
